description: Current-commit audit bundle contract for assembling release proof, audit handoff, SBOM/provenance, rollback drill, evidence index, risk register and pending external validation list.
evidenceSources: local-ci gate artifacts such as evidence coverage trend gate and evaluation trend gate
pending external validations from audit handoff

gatePolicy.localMode: May generate a blocked bundle when current release proof is local-contract or external live evidence is pending.
gatePolicy.requiredMode: Must fail unless all current-commit required evidence is present, clean, and passed.
gatePolicy.currentCommitRule: Every supplied evidence artifact with a commit field must match git HEAD.

privacyBoundary: Current audit bundle output must not embed real tokens, secrets, DSNs, private keys, production credentials, user report bodies or non-redacted production payloads.
nonClaims: Does not mean third-party audit passed.
Does not prove production API/HF/Bot live unless separate live evidence exists.
Does not prove real production rollback when rollback evidence is dry-run.
